mechanism_narrative: The approach of the late-November to December holiday shopping period raises discretionary retail footfall regardless of remaining restrictions, so RETAIL_REC is higher over the next four weeks than over the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:t-0w RETAIL_REC -17.0 is only 0.3 points above t-3w -17.9
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week improvement in TRANSIT of more than 2 points signals that mobility restrictions are loosening, which raises retail trips with a two-week lag and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 2 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -28.7 at t-1w to -25.3 at t-0w, a 3.4 point rise
failure_condition: When TRANSIT rises more than 2 points week-on-week, mean RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is not higher than the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: While RESIDENTIAL remains at least 6 points above baseline, households continue to substitute home-based activity for shopping trips, keeping RETAIL_REC below its recent mean over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays >= 6.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 7.3 at t-0w and 9.0 at t-1w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL is >= 6.0 for two weeks, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Easing workplace restrictions interact with transit recovery: when WORKPLACES is above -16 and TRANSIT is above -27, commuter flows return and lift RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -22.1 at t-1w to -14.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES > -16 and TRANSIT > -27, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Stable grocery and pharmacy spending near baseline, combined with a retail base more than 15 points below baseline, means essential-trip routines re-anchor discretionary shopping; RETAIL_REC rises over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was -3.0 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC was -17.0
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM >= -5.0 and RETAIL_REC <= -15.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Improving PARKS mobility, from -11.3 at t-3w to -8.3 at t-0w, indicates outdoor leisure substitution that draws trips away from retail and recreation, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -11.3 at t-3w to -8.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: When PARKS > -9.5, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls below -30, renewed mobility caution or tightening restrictions reduce retail trips, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT reached -28.7 at t-1w, near the -30 threshold
failure_condition: If TRANSIT < -30.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES rises above -15 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 6, workers return to commuting but continue local home-area spending, jointly lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES > -15 and RESIDENTIAL > 6, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the prior 28 days.
